description: Read an agent wallet's Orbio CREDIT on Robinhood Chain: ETH, USDG and CREDIT balances, the USDG allowance to the Orbio exchange and the current CREDIT per USDG. Pass the wallet's own Orbio key (sk-orb-...) to also read its activated inference balance from Orbio; the key is forwarded once and never stored. Pass activationTx to check Orbio has indexed an activation. Read-only.

apiKey.description: Optional Orbio wallet key, sk-orb-<epoch>-<base64 signature>. Sign "Orbio API key · chain 4663 · epoch 0" with the wallet (EIP-191) to make it.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663), where Orbio CREDIT trades.

name: credit_status
title: Read Orbio CREDIT status
